skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the concepts and processes of job analysis and performance management in relation to organizational strategic goals and HR activities such as compensation, training, and recruitment.
Analyze the application of job analysis in HR activities.
Analyze the application of performance management in employee compensation.
Create job descriptions, job requirement statements, and performance standards suitable for performance management.
Design KPIs based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) and select appropriate evaluation methods.
Define competency frameworks and design competency dictionaries.
Understand the elements of evaluation systems and the relationship between KPIs and organizational strategic goals.
Work effectively in groups and demonstrate self-learning and research skills.
Present, analyze, evaluate, and solve problems effectively.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems.
